payload.title: Install and select independent Cyclotron CLI lab and account contexts
payload.description:
Requested by Ryan for Claude through Kanbus (2026-10-30). This filing authorizes issue records only; implementation and any live identity/backend changes are subsequent work. No production login, deployment, IAM changes, secrets in chat, or direct message to Claude. Dot must operate from cloud/headless Linux without a Mac or AWS CLI. Optional shared auth libraries must not combine the two CLI products. Write executable behavioral specifications before implementation; use fake providers/stores in automated tests, and separately record any approved live evidence.

As a lab operator, I want a dedicated Cyclotron executable that targets one explicitly authorized lab/account at a time.

Acceptance: install and execute on clean Linux without Papyrus, a Mac or AWS CLI; document entry point, supported API operations, machine-readable output and exit codes. Discover/validate approved HTTPS lab metadata and bind issuer/client/audience/endpoint/account; ambiguous context requires explicit selection. Multiple labs and accounts retain independent session bindings. Local selection does not grant authority: server rechecks identity, current membership and operation/resource scope, including queued work. Reject endpoint substitution, revoked membership and cross-lab credential reuse. Preserve existing embedded/Papyrus integration APIs; reuse shared auth libraries only behind separate namespaces.

Feature: Independent lab CLI
  Scenario: Operate a selected lab
    Given two configured labs and valid authority for one account in each
    When I select a lab/account and run a protected operation
    Then only that endpoint receives the matching credential and enforces its account permissions
  Scenario: Missing authority
    Given no grant to the selected account or a revoked grant
    When a protected command is attempted
    Then it is denied without another lab credential or AWS fallback

References: pyproject.toml; docs/using-cyclotron.md; docs/decision-contract.md; docs/embedded-execution-authorization.md; src/decision_flywheel/publication_lab.py; queued_account_authorization.py. Define a fixture-driven read/write acceptance example before coding.
